summary.zh: 管理层支持者是倾向维护学校管理体系的学生。他们是玩家地下发展的关键风险源，可能举报、上报贿赂并提高管理层察觉。
summary.en: Administration Supporters are students who lean toward the school administration. They are a key risk to underground development and may report the organization, expose bribery, and raise faculty awareness.

items.zh: 管理层支持者更倾向相信规则、秩序和学校权威。
items.en: Administration supporters tend to believe in rules, order, and school authority.

items.zh: 他们通常更难建立高信任关系。
items.en: They are usually harder to build high trust with.

items.zh: 他们可能向管理层报告地下组织活动。
items.en: They may report underground organization activity to faculty.

items.zh: 对管理层支持者使用贿赂时，对方可能拿走手机并上报管理层。
items.en: When bribed, an administration supporter may take the phone and report the player to faculty.

items.zh: 这种行为会损失资源并提高管理层察觉。
items.en: This causes resource loss and increases faculty awareness.

items.zh: 因此，贿赂前确认目标派系非常重要。
items.en: Because of this, checking a target's faction before bribery is important.

items.zh: 优先通过侦查或学生详情识别他们。
items.en: Use scouting or student details to identify them first.

items.zh: 避免在他们附近执行过于高调的行动。
items.en: Avoid overly visible actions around them.

items.zh: 如果区域内管理层支持者很多，宣传和集会的风险会更高。
items.en: If a province contains many administration supporters, propaganda and rallies become riskier.
